q2_gaps: day-of-year date ('day 145 of Year 1') — the Time term (Day <n>) is the day-of-month slot (cf. 'June 5, 2021' -> (Day 5)); no day-of-year term is defined

plural multi-word proper name denoting a set ('the Salt-bloom Tide-pools') — Names and casing bars GroupOf on a name-labelled plural and offers only a singular kind atom, so the set-hood is unrecordable and a later member link ('the third pool') has to ride PartOf on an entity typed (Member ... tide_pool)

spatial-sequence ordinal ('the third pool from the north') — Ordinal's scale slot is defined only as the associated event or an explicit -est dimension, so an ordering direction has no licensed filler
notes: Coreference and role choices hold up throughout — 'the tide-pools' and 'the bucket' reuse their antecedents, the coordinated VPs in s8 share the party subject, and 'rose to ten weeks' correctly takes MeasureTo rather than a spatial Goal. 'eleven buckets of salt-bloom' is taken as a measure phrase ((Measure sk_salt_bloom_3 unspecified 11 bucket)) rather than eleven counted containers; the measure reading is the licensed one, so this is a live but defensible choice.
